title: StiqDesign
description: Stiq design document v1. The authoritative contract between the editor (stiq) and the engine (stiq-engine). All coordinates are world-space millimetres unless suffixed otherwise.

schemaVersion.description: Dated snapshot the document was written against, e.g. '2026-05-25'. Engines accept any version within their supported window (typically the last 12 months) and migrate older docs at the API boundary. Distinct from the package semver — package versions govern the codegen surface, doc versions govern the wire format.

elements.description: Ordered list of design elements. Stitch order follows array order (top-of-list = sewn first).

Hoop.title: Hoop
Hoop.description: Embroidery hoop dimensions. Origin is the hoop center (0,0).

origin.description: Origin convention. v1 only supports center-origin (0,0 = hoop center).

Transform.title: Transform
Transform.description: Element transform applied after geometry is defined in its local frame. Order: scale, then rotation around (0,0), then translation.

ThreadIdentity.title: ThreadIdentity
ThreadIdentity.description: Catalog identity for the thread. When present, the engine's PES writer uses the exact catalog entry instead of nearest-by-hex snapping. Hex remains authoritative for rendering.

catalogNumber.description: Brand's catalog identifier for the specific colour.

Element.description: A design element. Discriminated by `type`. v1 only defines satin; subsequent minor versions add spline, text, ellipse, rect, polygon, fills.

SatinElement.title: SatinElement
SatinElement.description: A satin column defined by two parallel rails (and optional rungs that override the engine's auto-pairing). Both rails are point lists in world-space mm, sampled the same direction.

label.description: Optional human-readable label shown in the editor's Layers panel.

rails.description: Exactly two rails. Each rail is a polyline of [xMm, yMm] points.

rungs.description: Optional explicit rungs (pairs of points joining the rails). When present, override the engine's automatic pairing.

items.description: Two points [[xMm, yMm], [xMm, yMm]] defining one rung.

SatinStitchSettings.title: SatinStitchSettings
SatinStitchSettings.description: Stitch settings specific to satin columns. Defaults match stitch-defaults.json (the legacy parity fixture) so v1 imports of pre-spine docs are loss-free.

densityAuto.description: When true, scale density by column width (sqrt of width / 4mm reference).

maxStitchMm.description: Maximum single stitch length in mm. Cap matches Brother PE700 acceptance.

minStitchMm.description: Minimum single stitch length in mm. Below this the engine merges.

pullCompMm.description: Perpendicular expansion in mm to offset thread-tension shrinkage.

pushCompMm.description: Parallel shortening in mm at column ends. 0 = engine auto-computes.

underlay.description: Whether to generate underlay stitches before the satin pass.

trimAfter.description: Force a trim after this element finishes sewing.
